title: French Maid Lace Gift Set with Headband | White | Lace with ruffle trim | Halloween Intimates | 85% Nylon, 15% Spandex | Adjustable straps
description:
The classic French maid silhouette, rebuilt as actual lingerie instead of a costume that falls apart. The apron panel is lined so it does not scratch, and the straps on the bodysuit are adjustable rather than fixed.

It ships as a box set: bodysuit, apron panel, and ruffled headband, packed together. That makes it straightforward to gift as well as to wear, which is where this style usually gets bought.

White reads very differently on camera than in person — under warm light it picks up cream. We have shot it to reflect that, so what you see is close to what arrives.

WHAT MAKES IT WORK
• Box set: bodysuit, apron panel, and headband together
• Lined apron panel — no scratchy raw edges against the skin
• Adjustable straps, not fixed-length
• White lace photographed under warm light to match real-world color
• Ships in gift-ready packaging

DETAILS
• Material: 85% Nylon, 15% Spandex; polyester lining
• Color: White
• Closure: Adjustable straps; elasticated back
• Pattern: Lace with ruffle trim
• Origin: Made in China
• Care: Hand wash cold. Line dry. Do not bleach.

FIT & SIZING
True to size. The bodysuit is fitted through the bust; size up if you are between sizes or prefer a looser feel.
Model is 5'9" (175 cm) with a 35" bust, wearing size S.

XS | 30–31 in | 26–27 in | 23–24 in | 33–34 in | 90–115 lb | US 0–2
S | 32–33 in | 28–29 in | 25–26 in | 35–36 in | 115–140 lb | US 4–6

XL | 39–41 in | 35–37 in | 32–34 in | 42–44 in | 190–215 lb | US 16–18

Sizing tips:
• Measure your underbust — the band directly under the bust, snug but not tight. This matters more than the bust measurement for anything with a bodysuit fit.
• Measure your hip at the widest point, roughly 8 inches below the waist. This is the number most people underestimate.
• If you are between sizes, size up for sleepwear and lounge pieces, and size down for fitted bodysuits where you want a close fit.
• Fabric stretch varies by style. Each product page lists how much give the fabric has — styles listed as "about 2 inches of stretch" will size down more easily.
• Between a standard size and an extended size? Take the standard size. The jump to extended sizing changes torso length and gusset volume, not just the measurements.

QUESTIONS WE GET A LOT
Q: What comes in the box?
A: A lace bodysuit, an apron panel, and a ruffled headband, packed together in gift-ready packaging.

Q: Is the apron scratchy?
A: The apron panel is lined, so the edges do not rub against skin the way costume aprons usually do.

Q: Will white look different on camera?
A: White lace picks up warm tones under indoor lighting and reads slightly cream. We have shot it under warm light so the photos are close to how it looks in person.

Q: Can I wear it without the apron and headband?
A: Yes. All three pieces are separate, so the bodysuit works as a standalone lace bodysuit too.
